title: Presence check does not enforce spec 18.5.3 low_battery rule
description:
File: rust/lichen-client/src/presence.rs (Presence::check, PresenceCacheEntry::check, apply_automatic_status, PresenceClient::put)

Spec 12-apps.md 18.5.3: when battery < 10%, add low_battery; otherwise leave status/activity unchanged and do not add the flag. apply_automatic_status implements that (Some(true) iff battery < LOW_BATTERY_PCT, else None).

Presence::check only rejects battery > 100. from_cbor/to_cbor therefore accept and emit contradictory documents, e.g. battery=87 with low_battery=true, or battery=5 with low_battery omitted, or low_battery=true with battery absent. PresenceClient::put will send those as a 2.04 PUT /presence body.

Public fields make the invalid state easy to construct; check() is the only gate on the wire.

Fix: in check(), require low_battery == Some(true) iff battery is Some(b) && b < LOW_BATTERY_PCT; omit or reject other combinations. Reject on both encode and decode so PUT/GET cannot advertise a false low-battery flag.

Perspectives: correctness, security.
